2. Theophrastus was a successor to Aristotle in the Peripatetic school, and he was succeeded by Strato of Lampsacus.
3. Strato of Lampsacus was a Peripatetic philosopher who succeeded Theophrastus as the head of the Lyceum.
4. Coriscus of Scepsis, Neleus' father, was a friend of Aristotle and a student of Plato.
5. Aristobulus of Alexandria was a Hellenistic Jewish philosopher of the Peripatetic school, but there is no mention of him teaching Neleus.
6. Lyco of Troas was a Peripatetic philosopher who succeeded Strato of Lampsacus as the head of the Peripatetic school, but he lived after Neleus' time.

From this information, it can be concluded that Neleus of Scepsis studied under Aristotle and Theophrastus in the Peripatetic school. There is no mention of him studying under any other teachers in the provided paragraphs.
